annotations.title: Enable or disable an integration, move it to another organization or set its secret lifetime

description: Enable or disable an integration, move it to another organization or set its secret lifetime.

organization.description: organization identification string to move the integration to, only an organization of the API application owner can be used, only the owner of the integration (or an administrator) can change the organization, send "none" (or an empty value) to remove the integration from its current organization, always the organization of the user for organizational members

secret_lifetime.description: optional secret lifetime in days, 0 for never, as in edubase_post_integration

name: edubase_patch_integration
